add.title: list_waiting counts each wait once, at the task that holds it
add.why: Past-work audit slice 1 (/live/audit/): of the newest 20 'waiting on you' items only 6 are real questions. A plan handed down waits on both agents (items 1/2, 4/5, 6/16); an agent's root session is listed whenever a subtask waits (16, 17, 19, 20); a nested task is listed at its own folder and again at its parent's (9-11 = 12-14); a ProcessRunner merge wait outlives its merge by 17 days (7, 8). Fix in the waiting query, not by closing items by hand.

log.msg: Slice 2 (items 21–40, /live/audit/) adds two more causes: (4) a daily check-in re-posts a waiting task as a NEW decision card each day, so one waiting voice call shows 4 times (items 21–24, 26–29); (5) a wait never ends when its agent does: 10-17 budget pauses on helpers long gone (35–40; budget caps are no longer stop-points since 2026-11-04), voice calls that ended 11-03 (28, 29). Fix shape: dedupe a decision against the task it re-posts, and drop any wait whose agent has ended. Of 40 items, 7 are real questions.

log.text: Cause 6 (audit slice 3, /live/audit/ items 43, 54, 55, 56): any card left with an open reply box counts as waiting, even a mic check or a test card, and a card decision stays open after its work was built. Also: 9 waiting tasks from session-e00f55c9 have no `at`, so they sort last. Fix: count a card only when it asks something, and close a card decision when its task lands.

add.title: Item: a wait (or state) given inside tasks.add should start the wait, not sit as plain data
add.why: tasks.add({..., wait: {on: 'owner', what}}) stores wait as a data field: the task stays idle and list_waiting never shows it. Three real owner questions in mastermind-session-truth (t11, t12, t19) were invisible this way from 11-07 to 11-09, while t21, set with a separate wait() call, showed. Fix: Task's add path calls wait() for a wait field (or refuses it loudly). Found in the 'waiting on you' audit, slice 4: /live/audit/.

log.text: Slice 4 (items 61-85): no real question among the 25. Cause 7: owner asks filed by the prompt filer before 2026-10-24 are proposals still waiting for an approve (items 77-85, session-e00f55c9; 175 were filed that way); the filer now files them open, but the old ones were never moved. Cause 8, the opposite way: a wait given inside tasks.add never waits, so real questions are missing from the list (separate task item-a-wait-or-state-given-inside-tasks).

add.title: Pool worktrees collect writes meant for the main tree; close_task then refuses them
add.why: 2026-11-09 ui-kit: qf-4/qf-5 hold uncommitted public/live/*page.jsonl appends from other agents, a stray session-4fab735e/ folder, and a minion's past-work-answer.md written into its worktree instead of main. close_task refused both (left: worktree has uncommitted changes), so slots stay held. A minion's task records should be written to the main tree (or the merge should carry them), and page.jsonl appends should never land in a pool worktree.

add.title: A minion's auto-written `complete` outcome is its turn transcript, not a result
add.why: 2026-11-09 ui-kit step-1/session.jsonl: the complete line's outcome reads "Now let's take a worktree and start building. Good, `ui` is importable…" — the assistant's running narration, while the real result was in its done message. The outcome should be the done message (or the minion's own complete line), never the concatenated turn text.
